description: This file implements the HmacSerializable class, which provides serialization and deserialization of HMAC-based secure data, including integrity verification and optional additional authenticated data (AAD). It interacts with TPM resources and cryptographic functions to produce and verify HMACs.

classes.name: HmacSerializable
classes.description: A class that handles serialization, deserialization, and integrity verification of data using HMAC, with support for additional authenticated data (AAD).

methods.name: HmacSerializable::SerializedSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the serialized data, including the digest and wrapped data.

methods.name: HmacSerializable::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the wrapped data, computes an HMAC, and appends it to the buffer.

methods.name: HmacSerializable::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data, verifies HMAC integrity, and performs inner deserialization of wrapped data.

methods.name: HmacSerializable::AppendAad
methods.description: Appends optional additional authenticated data (AAD) to the sensitive data for HMAC computation.
